envelope.description: Widen the CodeReviewSubject fields + trim the failure-reason union

body.title: Widen the CodeReviewSubject fields + trim the failure-reason union
body.summary: In src/workflow/code-review/types.ts, change CodeReviewSubject.approvedLld to LldArtifact|null and approvedPlan to PlanArtifact|null, and trim the CodeReviewSubjectResult failure union from {reason:'no-approved-contract'|'no-build-record'} to {reason:'no-build-record'}. Pure type-surface change; no runtime logic here.
acceptanceChecks: CodeReviewSubject.approvedLld and approvedPlan are typed `LldArtifact | null` / `PlanArtifact | null`
CodeReviewSubjectResult's ok:false member is exactly {ok:false; reason:'no-build-record'} — 'no-approved-contract' is gone
tsc surfaces every downstream call site that now must handle null (drives t2–t4)

tests.name: tsc over the code-review module compiles with CodeReviewSubject.approvedLld/approvedPlan nullable and the trimmed no-build-record-only failure union (type-shape assertion)
